name: query_walk_in_clinic
description: Queries patient visit history and blood test results from Downtown Walk-In Clinic.

key.description: Lookup key. Use 'FIRSTNAME_LASTNAME' (e.g. 'JOHN_SMITH') to list a patient's visit dates at this clinic, or 'FIRSTNAME_LASTNAME:DD-MM-YYYY' (e.g. 'JOHN_SMITH:04-10-2026') to retrieve the detailed lab panel and clinician notes for a specific visit date.
